question: Show wallet transactions of January 2026
sql: SELECT wt.id, u.id AS user_id, u.name, wt.amount, wt.reference_type, wt.transaction_type, wt.status, wt.remark, wt.created_at FROM wallet_transaction AS wt JOIN users AS u ON u.id = wt.user_id WHERE wt.created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-02-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY wt.created_at DESC LIMIT 500

question: List 5 approved retailers
sql: SELECT u.id AS retailer_id, u.name, u.mobile_number, u.email, u.user_role, u.city, u.district, u.address, u.wallet_balance, u.status, u.created_at FROM users AS u WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND u.status = 'approved' ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT 500

question: Show total withdrawal requests by status
sql: SELECT wr.id AS withdrawal_id, u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.mobile_number, wr.amount, wr.status, wr.tds_amount, wr.created_at FROM withdrawal_request AS wr JOIN users AS u ON wr.user_id = u.id ORDER BY wr.created_at DESC LIMIT 500

question: List 5 automatic transactions with IMPS transfer type
sql: SELECT at.id, at.user_id, u.name, at.amount, at.transfer_type, at.status, at.bank_reference_number, at.created_at FROM automatic_transactions AS at JOIN users AS u ON at.user_id = u.id ORDER BY at.created_at DESC LIMIT 500
